description:
### PixelBoard Patches (v1.0.4)

* **Gemini Rambler Voice Typing**: Auto-cleanup, sentence restructuring, auto-punctuation, and idle battery drain fix
* **In-Line AI Writing Assistant**: Proofread, rephrase, and tone switcher
* **Google Signature Bypass**: Bypass signature whitelist checks
* **Standalone Coexistence**: Side-by-side installation with stock Gboard

Supports Gboard v18.0.3 (Stable) and v18.3.1 (Release / Beta).
